summary: the agents suite on x86-64 against faults in the agents layer's recipes of gh, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI and muse, in the kernel that Claude Code's sessions meet and in the worker loop; RACH2_AGENTS_ROWS, chosen by the phase, runs only the rows of the phase's fault, and every fault's rows in the base; the suite stages the packages and builds the root again from a changed recipe

argv: ARCH=x86_64 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && ARCH=x86_64 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel && cp vendor/gnu/agents/packages/gh.sh vendor/gnu/agents/packages/claude.sh vendor/gnu/agents/packages/codex.sh vendor/gnu/agents/packages/agy.sh vendor/gnu/agents/packages/muse.sh tools/flow/worker.sh ${WORK}/

case ${PHASE} in *-gh) rows='gh' ;; *-claude) rows='claude' ;; *-codex) rows='codex codex-screen' ;; *-agy) rows='agy' ;; *-muse) rows='muse' ;; *-procfs) rows='claude-print claude-screen' ;; *-worker) rows='worker-session' ;; *-sandbox) rows='codex-exec codex-screen' ;; *) rows='gh claude codex codex-screen agy muse claude-print claude-screen worker-session codex-exec' ;; esac; ARCH=x86_64 RACH2_AGENTS_ROWS="$rows" exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run agents

faults.name: gh
faults.summary: gh's link in /usr/bin, which the recipe makes, points at a file the package does not have, so that the path finds no such program

faults.name: claude
faults.summary: Claude Code's managed settings give DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER in place of DISABLE_UPDATES, which stops only the background update, so that `claude update` tries to fetch a release

lines: AGENTROW FAIL claude: claude update: status 1

faults.name: codex
faults.summary: Codex's daemon_auto_start is turned on in /etc/codex/config.toml, so that Codex starts its background server, which outlives the screen of the codex-screen row too

lines: AGENTROW FAIL codex: the processes: got [
AGENTROW FAIL codex-screen: codex's screen: the processes left: got [

faults.name: agy
faults.summary: /etc/profile.d/agy.sh sets AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE to false, so that a login shell leaves Antigravity CLI's updater on

lines: AGENTROW FAIL agy: the updater's setting in a login shell: got [false], want [true]

faults.name: muse
faults.summary: muse's link in /usr/bin, which the recipe makes, points at a file the package does not have, so that the path finds no such program

faults.name: procfs
faults.summary: a path stops at /proc/PID/fd/N of a file or a directory with ENOTDIR, as Rach2 did before it followed the link; Claude Code's Bash tool makes its files through such a path

edits.find: if ((e->type == FD_TYPE_FILE || e->type == FD_TYPE_DIR) && e->ofd && e->ofd->vmnt) {

faults.name: worker
faults.summary: tools/flow/worker.sh gives its session the prompt with @ISSUE@ in place of the issue's number, which the worker-session row's verifier must find in the first request of the session on #901

lines: the session has no worker's prompt for #901

faults.name: sandbox
faults.summary: sandbox_mode is workspace-write in Codex's /etc/codex/config.toml, so that Codex runs the model's commands in its sandbox, which Rach2 cannot make
